title: HODL Machine
tagline: Paper hands, fear no more: introducing the HODL machine, a machine that forces you to hold assets for a specified period of time.
description: People can use this app to put their assets in a smart contract escrow, which prevents them from removing their assets for a period of time. This allows people to coordinate with their future self and hold through the bear market. It also is a public statement of one's faith in a project.
how_its_made: This project uses React on the front end and Gnosis Safe on the back end. The user follows the instructions to start a new Safe, generates and deploys a transaction guard via the website, and then calls a contracts on the Safe to add the transaction guard. It's a very simple project, and obviously more technical / functional than nice looking. I'm a solo hacker with little previous dev experience :)
